craft_notes: Sthāyin: the two-poison seat (fire/poison middle — the crossing image). Rows: row 2 (wind-filled or memory-yoked). Close: bliss (the either-or both land sweet: refrain of ananda). Rejected: 'venom' — killed: poison kept (viṣa); 'imagine' — killed: remembrance-bliss kept (smara as method).

lines: Fire and poison, middle: mind happiness-made cast —
mere wind-filled, or yoked by remembrance-bliss.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vahner viṣasya madhye tu cittaṃ sukhamayaṃ kṣipet | kevalaṃ vāyupūrṇaṃ vā smarānandena yujyate

reads_against.argmap: Where is mind cast amid fire and poison? → Cast happiness-made between fire and poison, mind yokes by remembrance-bliss.
c1_essence: Mind happiness-cast between fire-poison: yoked by memory-bliss.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta charged with vīra (wonder armed with intensity)
